title: The Hungry Portrait
author: Edmund Underhill
blurb: Petra Ishikawa, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
